display_name: Terminate a tracked MCP bridge subprocess (macOS plugin)
description: macOS implementation of terminate_bridge: SIGTERM the tracked subprocess, wait up to the grace window, SIGKILL on overrun, drop the tracking entry. Bound-provider skip semantics mean callers should route through service_interface::coding_agent_session_service::terminate_bridge instead of this plugin::* key.
embedding_description: macOS-side terminate of a tracked MCP bridge subprocess with SIGTERM-then-SIGKILL semantics. Mirrors the canonical service_interface::coding_agent_session_service::terminate_bridge contract. Returns BridgeTerminateResult.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: BridgeTerminateResult frozen dataclass mirroring the canonical service interface return.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: macOS-side terminate of an MCP bridge subprocess.
